description: This file contains unit tests for the data asset lifecycle management API, verifying CRUD operations and business rules such as uniqueness and soft delete behavior.

classes.name: DbBackedAssetLifecycleTests
classes.description: Contains integration test methods for asset lifecycle API endpoints, verifying creation, update, deletion, and validation logic.

methods.name: Create_asset_persists_and_returns_201_with_id
methods.description: Tests successful asset creation returns HTTP 201 and includes asset ID in response.

methods.name: Create_asset_rejects_duplicate_permit_eu_id_with_409
methods.description: Ensures creating an asset with a duplicate permit EU ID results in HTTP 409 Conflict.

methods.name: Update_asset_persists_changed_fields
methods.description: Checks that updating an asset persists the changes and can be retrieved accurately.

methods.name: Delete_asset_soft_deletes_and_subsequent_get_is_404
methods.description: Verifies that deleting an asset performs a soft delete and subsequent retrieval returns 404.
